from manim import *

class MainScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        # SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION (0–8 seconds)
        # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        
        title = Text("Merge Sort Algorithm", font_size=48, color=BLUE_B).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(title)
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        intro_text = Text(
            "A divide-and-conquer algorithm\nfor efficient sorting",
            font_size=28,
            color=WHITE
        ).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.8)
        self.play(Write(intro_text), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Why it matters
        why_text = Text(
            "Time Complexity: O(n log n)",
            font_size=24,
            color=YELLOW
        ).next_to(intro_text, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        self.play(Write(why_text), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Fade out intro section
        self.play(
            FadeOut(intro_text),
            FadeOut(why_text),
            run_time=0.8
        )
        self.wait(0.3)
        
        # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        # SECTION 2: CORE CONCEPT – DIVIDE (8–30 seconds)
        # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        
        concept_label = Text(
            "Step 1: Divide",
            font_size=36,
            color=GREEN
        ).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.8)
        self.play(Write(concept_label), run_time=1)
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # Create initial unsorted array visualization
        unsorted_array = [5, 2, 8, 1, 9, 3, 7, 4]
        array_boxes = VGroup()
        
        for i, val in enumerate(unsorted_array):
            box = Rectangle(width=0.6, height=0.6, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.3)
            text = Text(str(val), font_size=20)
            item = VGroup(box, text)
            item.arrange(CENTER)
            
            if i == 0:
                item.next_to(concept_label, DOWN, buff=1.2)
            else:
                item.next_to(array_boxes[i-1], RIGHT, buff=0.15)
            
            array_boxes.add(item)
        
        self.play(
            *[FadeIn(box, scale=0.8) for box in array_boxes],
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Show division process
        division_text = Text(
            "Recursively divide into halves",
            font_size=22,
            color=CYAN
        ).next_to(array_boxes, DOWN, buff=0.8)
        self.play(Write(division_text), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1.5)
        
        # Fade and prepare for second level
        self.play(
            FadeOut(division_text),
            run_time=0.5
        )
        self.wait(0.3)
        
        # Show first division into two halves
        left_array = unsorted_array[:4]
        right_array = unsorted_array[4:]
        
        # Move first half left, second half right
        left_group = VGroup(*array_boxes[:4])
        right_group = VGroup(*array_boxes[4:])
        
        self.play(
            left_group.animate.shift(LEFT * 2.5),
            right_group.animate.shift(RIGHT * 2.5),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Label the halves
        left_label = Text("Left Half", font_size=18, color=YELLOW).next_to(left_group, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        right_label = Text("Right Half", font_size=18, color=YELLOW).next_to(right_group, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        self.play(
            Write(left_label),
            Write(right_label),
            run_time=1
        )
        self.wait(1.5)
        
        # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        # SECTION 3: RECURSIVE DIVISION (30–55 seconds)
        # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        
        self.play(
            FadeOut(left_label),
            FadeOut(right_label),
            run_time=0.5
        )
        self.wait(0.3)
        
        # Further divide left half
        left_left = left_group[:2]
        left_right = left_group[2:]
        
        self.play(
            left_left.animate.shift(DOWN * 1.5 + LEFT * 0.8),
            left_right.animate.shift(DOWN * 1.5 + RIGHT * 0.8),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # Further divide right half
        right_left = right_group[:2]
        right_right = right_group[2:]
        
        self.play(
            right_left.animate.shift(DOWN * 1.5 + LEFT * 0.8),
            right_right.animate.shift(DOWN * 1.5 + RIGHT * 0.8),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.wait(0.8)
        
        # Add dividing text
        divide_more = Text(
            "Continue until single elements",
            font_size=20,
            color=CYAN
        ).to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.5)
        self.play(Write(divide_more), run_time=1)
        self.wait(1.5)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(divide_more), run_time=0.5)
        
        # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        # SECTION 4: MERGE PROCESS (55–95 seconds)
        # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        
        # Clear previous for clean presentation
        self.play(
            *[FadeOut(box) for box in array_boxes],
            run_time=1
        )
        self.wait(0.3)
        
        # Fade out concept label
        self.play(FadeOut(concept_label), run_time=0.5)
        
        # New section: Merge
        merge_label = Text(
            "Step 2: Merge",
            font_size=36,
            color=PURPLE
        ).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.8)
        self.play(Write(merge_label), run_time=1)
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # Show merge example with sorted pairs
        merge_example_text = Text(
            "Compare and merge sorted halves",
            font_size=22,
            color=CYAN
        ).next_to(merge_label, DOWN, buff=1)
        self.play(Write(merge_example_text), run_time=1)
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Create two small sorted arrays to merge
        arr1 = [2, 5]
        arr2 = [1, 8]
        
        arr1_boxes = VGroup()
        for i, val in enumerate(arr1):
            box = Rectangle(width=0.5, height=0.5, color=RED, fill_opacity=0.4)
            text = Text(str(val), font_size=18)
            item = VGroup(box, text)
            item.arrange(CENTER)
            if i == 0:
                item.next_to(merge_example_text, DOWN, buff=0.8).shift(LEFT * 1.2)
            else:
                item.next_to(arr1_boxes[i-1], RIGHT, buff=0.1)
            arr1_boxes.add(item)
        
        arr2_boxes = VGroup()
        for i, val in enumerate(arr2):
            box = Rectangle(width=0.5, height=0.5, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.4)
            text = Text(str(val), font_size=18)
            item = VGroup(box, text)
            item.arrange(CENTER)
            if i == 0:
                item.next_to(merge_example_text, DOWN, buff=0.8).shift(RIGHT * 1.2)
            else:
                item.next_to(arr2_boxes[i-1], RIGHT, buff=0.1)
            arr2_boxes.add(item)
        
        self.play(
            *[FadeIn(box, scale=0.8) for box in arr1_boxes],
            *[FadeIn(box, scale=0.8) for box in arr2_boxes],
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.wait(0.8)
        
        # Arrow and result
        arrow = Arrow(
            merge_example_text.get_bottom(),
            ORIGIN + DOWN * 0.5,
            color=GREEN,
            stroke_width=3
        ).scale(0.6)
        self.play(GrowArrow(arrow), run_time=0.8)
        
        # Merged result
        merged = [1, 2, 5, 8]
        merged_boxes = VGroup()
        for i, val in enumerate(merged):
            box = Rectangle(width=0.5, height=0.5, color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.5)
            text = Text(str(val), font_size=18)
            item = VGroup(box, text)
            item.arrange(CENTER)
            if i == 0:
                item.next_to(arrow, DOWN, buff=0.6)
            else:
                item.next_to(merged_boxes[i-1], RIGHT, buff=0.1)
            merged_boxes.add(item)
        
        self.play(
            *[FadeIn(box, scale=0.8) for box in merged_boxes],
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1.5)
        
        # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        # SECTION 5: FULL ALGORITHM SUMMARY (95–110 seconds)
        # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        
        # Fade out merge example
        self.play(
            *[FadeOut(box) for box in arr1_boxes],
            *[FadeOut(box) for box in arr2_boxes],
            *[FadeOut(box) for box in merged_boxes],
            FadeOut(merge_example_text),
            FadeOut(arrow),
            run_time=1
        )
        self.wait(0.3)
        
        # Summary section
        self.play(FadeOut(merge_label), run_time=0.5)
        
        summary_title = Text(
            "Merge Sort Summary",
            font_size=36,
            color=BLUE_B
        ).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.8)
        self.play(Write(summary_title), run_time=1)
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # Key points
        point1 = Text(
            "1. Divide: Split array into halves recursively",
            font_size=20,
            color=WHITE
        ).next_to(summary_title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        self.play(Write(point1), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(0.8)
        
        point2 = Text(
            "2. Merge: Combine sorted subarrays",
            font_size=20,
            color=WHITE
        ).next_to(point1, DOWN, buff=0.4)
        self.play(Write(point2), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(0.8)
        
        point3 = Text(
            "3. Result: Fully sorted array in O(n log n)",
            font_size=20,
            color=YELLOW
        ).next_to(point2, DOWN, buff=0.4)
        self.play(Write(point3), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1.5)
        
        # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        # SECTION 6: OUTRO (110–120 seconds)
        # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        
        # Fade out summary
        self.play(
            FadeOut(summary_title),
            FadeOut(point1),
            FadeOut(point2),
            FadeOut(point3),
            run_time=1
        )
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # Final message
        final_text = Text(
            "Merge Sort: Elegant & Efficient",
            font_size=40,
            color=GREEN
        )
        self.play(Write(final_text), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1.5)
        
        # Fade to black
        self.play(FadeOut(final_text), FadeOut(title), run_time=2)
        self.wait(0.5)
